p.small: mediators (−$110), colliders (−$806) — adjusting fabricates new bias

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.b: Three assumptions must hold for adjustment to work at all
p.small: unconfoundedness (untestable) · positivity (185/185 overlap at baseline; a +9yr shift drops it to 118/185) · SUTVA (spillover understates: $987 vs $1,794)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Propensity score e(x) reduces X to one scalar
high-dimensional matching fails (6,561 cells, 42 populated) · e(x) must be built for balance, not prediction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.b: Six estimators, all scored against the same $1,794
p.small: stratification · matching · IPW (+ trimming) · regression adjustment · AIPW (doubly robust — consistent if either nuisance model is right)

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: overlap matters more than estimator sophistication — and every method reduces to e(x) and μ_t(x), where flexible ML takes over next
